name: HC09: New ART clients with baseline CD4 <200
description: New ART clients with baseline CD4 below 200 cells/mm3
creator: 82f18b44-6814-11e8-923f-e9a88dcb533f
sqlTemplate: SELECT DISTINCT s.client_id AS patient_id FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_summary s WHERE s.baseline_regimen_start_date >= :startDate AND s.baseline_regimen_start_date < :endDate AND s.baseline_cd4 IS NOT NULL AND CAST(s.baseline_cd4 AS UNSIGNED) < 200
